title: GTA 6 Could Unlock at 9 PM on the West Coast: Start Times by Time Zone ⏰ #Shorts
description:
Rockstar's support page says GTA 6 releases at midnight local time on November 19, 2026 (PS5 and Xbox Series X|S). Outlets report US store listings run on Eastern time, so midnight ET = 11 PM CT, 10 PM MT and 9 PM PT on November 18. Rockstar hasn't published a per-time-zone chart: check your own store page.

Sources: Rockstar Games Support; Forbes (Nov 12, 2026); Push Square.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
